title: Church jobs: St. Francis de Sales and sanctified churches
summary: Dawson played in St. Francis de Sales later in life and earlier played guitar and mandolin for spiritual churches that sang, danced and beat tambourines, for a salary.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
